info.title: Skein API
info.description:
REST/JSON API of Skein, a collaborative, offline-capable notes workspace. The gateway translates each route to a gRPC call on a backend service; the gRPC contracts in proto/skein/v1 are the source of truth.

Conventions (docs/api/README.md): JSON field names are lowerCamelCase; 64-bit integers and bytes are JSON strings (decimal and base64); enums are their names; timestamps are RFC 3339. Errors are google.rpc.Status objects. Every request needs `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` except sign-up, sign-in and token refresh. POST requests accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. Responses carry `X-Request-Id` and the rate-limit headers `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset`, plus `Retry-After` on 429.

Live sync, the agent's streamed output and live notifications are WebSocket endpoints, described in docs/api/websocket.md and not in this document.

get.description:
The notes within reach of a note, by hop, in the requested direction. By
default the direction is BLAST_DIRECTION_CITED_BY: the notes that link to
this one, directly or transitively, which are the notes affected if this
one changes.

401.description: Missing, malformed or expired access token (UNAUTHENTICATED).

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED). Retry after the number of seconds in the Retry-After header.

parameters.name: maxHops
parameters.description: 0 means no limit.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
Unspecified means BLAST_DIRECTION_CITED_BY.

 - BLAST_DIRECTION_UNSPECIFIED: Treated as BLAST_DIRECTION_CITED_BY.
 - BLAST_DIRECTION_CITED_BY: Follow links backwards, to the notes that link to the source: "if this
note changes, these notes are affected".
 - BLAST_DIRECTION_CITES: Follow links forwards, to the notes the source links to: "this note
depends on these".

post.summary: Apply a batch of CRDT operations
post.description:
Applies a batch of CRDT operations from a client that is not streaming
(the agent, imports, tests). Operations are idempotent: re-sending a
batch already applied changes nothing, so a retry is always safe. The
whole batch is refused with PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller may not edit
the note.

post.description:
Records that a CRDT replica ID belongs to the calling user (ADR-0004).
Browser-facing: each device mints its replica ID in IndexedDB and
registers it before its first sync. Documents accepts operations from a
replica only on connections authenticated as the user who registered it,
so blame cannot be forged. Registering an ID the caller already owns
succeeds; one owned by someone else fails with ALREADY_EXISTS and the
client must mint a new ID.

and phrase search. Regex mode runs an RE2 regular expression over block

Action.description:
Every action a subject can attempt. Services authorize with these values,
never with free-form strings.

componentOf.description: Connected component of each note, ignoring link direction.

orphanComponents.description: Components that contain no root note.

sccOf.description:
Strongly connected component of each note, following link direction.
Numbered so the component holding the smallest note ID is 0.

cycle.description: One example cycle, first equals last; empty if the graph is acyclic.

topologicalOrder.description:
A reading order where no note comes before one it links to. Partial when
the graph has cycles; the rest is in unplaced.

communityOf.description: Louvain communities and the modularity of that partition.

replicaId.description: A replica registered by the caller (RegisterReplica). JSON string.

ops.description: A batch in the wire format of docs/spec/crdt-sequence.md. Base64 in JSON.

allowed.description: One entry per check, in the same order.

runs.description: Repetitions per algorithm; means are reported. 0 means 1.

seed.description:
Seed for every random choice, so a benchmark can be replayed. JSON
string.

start.description:
Half-open range [start, end) in code points of the current text
(ADR-0003); the browser converts to UTF-16.

agentRunId.description: Set when an agent run made the edit for user_id.

BlastDirection.description:
Which links a blast radius follows.

 - BLAST_DIRECTION_UNSPECIFIED: Treated as BLAST_DIRECTION_CITED_BY.
 - BLAST_DIRECTION_CITED_BY: Follow links backwards, to the notes that link to the source: "if this
note changes, these notes are affected".
 - BLAST_DIRECTION_CITES: Follow links forwards, to the notes the source links to: "this note
depends on these".

hops.description:
Notes reached, with their hop distance from the source; the source
itself is included at distance 0.

ringSizes.description: Number of notes at each distance; ring_sizes[0] is the source itself.

blockId.description: "replica:counter" of the block marker, in decimal.

start.description: Half-open range [start, end) in code points.

BlockRef.description:
A location inside a note: the block and, optionally, a character range in
code points within the block's text (ADR-0003; the browser converts to
UTF-16). start == end == 0 means the whole block.

resourceId.description: A note ID or a workspace ID, depending on the action.

ClusteringAlgorithm.description:
- CLUSTERING_ALGORITHM_KMEANS_RANDOM: Lloyd iterations with random initialisation.
 - CLUSTERING_ALGORITHM_KMEANS_PLUS_PLUS: Lloyd iterations with k-means++ initialisation.
 - CLUSTERING_ALGORITHM_KMEANS_ELKAN: k-means++ initialisation, Elkan's triangle-inequality pruning.
 - CLUSTERING_ALGORITHM_GMM_EM: Gaussian mixture fitted by expectation maximisation.
 - CLUSTERING_ALGORITHM_E_MEANS: e-means (Meta FAIR, 2026): mini-batch k-means with exponential moving
average updates, scaling-law batch and step sizes, a cosine step
schedule, dead-cluster revival and an exact closing pass. See
docs/research/e-means.md.

implementation.description:
Implementation that produced it: "scratch" (this repository), or a
reference: "sklearn", or "faiss" for e-means.

objective.description:
Sum of squared distances to centroids (K-means) or negative mean
log-likelihood (Gaussian mixtures). Lower is better.

distanceComputations.description: Distance computations, to show what Elkan's pruning saves.

epochs.description: Passes over the data; e-means aims for 1.2 to 3 where Lloyd needs 20+.

testObjective.description: Objective on held-out points, the fair comparison between algorithms.

deadClusters.description: Clusters left with fewer than ten points.

confirmationId.description: From the ConfirmationRequest event the run streamed.

approved.description: False stops the run without performing the action.

ConfirmationRequest.description:
Sent before a destructive or outward-facing action. The run is paused
until Confirm is called.

noteId.description: Optional note the chat is about.

markdown.example:
# Raft log compaction
Snapshots bound the log.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working. Unset means it never expires.

token.description: Returned once; only a hash is stored.

GraphEdge.description: A link: the note `from` contains a [[link]] to the note `to`.

isRoot.description:
A designated entry point of the workspace. Components that contain no
root are reported as orphans by AnalyzeGraph.

unread.description: Total unread notifications in the inbox, for the badge.

trashed.description: True while the note is in the trash.

NoteVersion.description:
A version is a point in history: everything up to a version vector,
grouped by author and time for display.

pageSize.description: Maximum items to return. The server may return fewer. 0 means the default.

pageToken.description: Token from a previous response's next_page_token; empty for the first page.

PageRequest.description:
Cursor-based pagination. Page tokens are opaque to clients. Over REST the
fields are query parameters: `?page.pageSize=50&page.pageToken=...`.

nextPageToken.description: Empty when there are no more pages.

PathMetric.description:
- PATH_METRIC_HOPS: Link hops, ignoring direction.
 - PATH_METRIC_SEMANTIC: Sum of (1 - cosine similarity) along links.

inApp.description: Show in the inbox and push live.

anchor.description: Cursor and selection anchored to element IDs ("replica:counter").

reason.description: Why this note is in the path, for example "linked from X".

replicaId.description: The replica whose change groups to undo or redo. JSON string.

ops.description:
The operations generated and applied, in the CRDT wire format. Base64 in
JSON.

replicaId.description:
Random 64-bit ID minted by the device. A JSON string, because uint64
does not fit a JavaScript number.

hops.description: Link distance ignoring direction; -1 means not connected.

suggestLink.description: True when meaning is close but the notes are not linked.

highlights.description: Match ranges inside snippet, in code points.

SearchMode.description:
- SEARCH_MODE_TEXT: Words and phrases, typo-tolerant.
 - SEARCH_MODE_REGEX: Regular expression over block text, accelerated by the trigram index.

candidates.description:
How many blocks the trigram index proposed and how many matched, so the
index's selectivity is visible.

cosine.description: Cosine similarity between query and block embeddings, in [-1, 1].

refreshToken.description: Opaque rotating token (days). Each refresh returns a new one.

Session.description:
A signed-in session. Send access_token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`;
keep refresh_token secret and use it only with Refresh and SignOut.

role.description:
NOTE_ROLE_UNSPECIFIED removes the override and falls back to the
workspace role.
WORKSPACE_ROLE_UNSPECIFIED is rejected; use RemoveMember to remove.

found.description: False when no path exists; path is then empty.

path.description: Note IDs from `from` to `to`, both included.

cost.description: Total cost under the requested metric.

code.description: The authorization code the provider returned to redirect_uri.

codeVerifier.description: The PKCE verifier whose challenge started the flow.

redirectUri.description: Must equal the redirect URI used to start the flow.

created.description: True when this sign-in created the account.

password.description:
Stored only as an Argon2id hash and never logged (ADR-0008). Identity
rejects weak passwords with INVALID_ARGUMENT.

agentRunId.description: Set when an agent run acts for user_id.

Subject.description: Who is acting: a user, or an agent run acting for a user.

rejected.description:
Operations the server refused (for example after access was revoked
while the client was offline). The client drops them and keeps their
text as a draft.

editDistance.description:
Edit distance between the typed prefix and the title; 0 is an exact
prefix match.

argumentsJson.description: Arguments as JSON, matching the tool's schema.

summary.description: Short human summary, for example "Read 3 notes".

replicaId.description: The replica whose change groups to undo or redo. JSON string.

ops.description:
The operations generated and applied, in the CRDT wire format. Base64 in
JSON.

replicaId.description: JSON string: uint64 does not fit a JavaScript number.

counter.description: Highest operation counter seen from that replica. JSON string.

VersionVector.description: Version vector entries, sorted by replica_id.

bearer.description: An access token from sign-in, sign-up or refresh, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens are short-lived; refresh with POST /v1/sessions:refresh.
bearer.name: Authorization

externalDocs.description: REST conventions, error model and WebSocket endpoints
